{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.14

|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns object the given object is attached to or [[objNull]] if the given object is not attached to anything.

|s1= [[attachedTo]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - given object

|r1= [[Object]] - object the given object is attached to

|x1= <sqf>
if (isNull attachedTo _obj1) then
{
	hint "_obj1 is not attached to anything.";
};
</sqf>
